description: This file defines the SharedStorageImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to shared storage management, including configuration, notification, cache, and limit controls. It includes nested classes for notifications and jobs, and declares methods for setting, getting, deleting storage keys/namespaces, and managing storage limits and cache. The file also manages external dependencies and internal synchronization mechanisms.
